The solitary child's posture is quiet and observant; facial expressions are neutral and the reason for the separation is ambiguous. Do not depict bullying, distress, ridicule, or visible rejection. Transparent background with only subtle grounding shadows. Landscape composition about 3:2, tightly framed around the people with generous separation between the child and group. This sits on a warm off-white (#F6F3ED) slide background. No text, no arrows, no masks, no icons, no border.
